mapper.select:
select
from PTL_POSITION_SCENE

select
from PTL_POSITION_FLOW_CFG
select ACCT_NO from PTL_CAPACCT_INFO where PORTFOLIO_ID =#{portfolioId} and acct_type='A01' and ccy=#{ccy}
select TRD_ACCT_ID from STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO where sec_acct_id= #{secAcctId}

select SEQNO,AMOUNT,PORTFOLIO_ID,SEC_ACCT_ID,FINPROD_ID,BRANCH,INV_AIM,HODING_TYPE,CDATE,ccy,P_FINPROD_ID,TRADE_ID from ETR_SEC_POSITION_FLOW where TRADE_ID=#{entrustId} and OFFSET_ID is null and OFFSET_FLAG = '01'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW F WHERE F.ENTRUST_ID = ETR_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.TRADE_ID and F.OFFSET_ID is null and F.OFFSET_FLAG = '01')

select sum(amount) amount,PORTFOLIO_ID,SEC_ACCT_ID,FINPROD_ID,BRANCH,INV_AIM,HODING_TYPE,CDATE,ccy,P_FINPROD_ID,TRADE_ID from ETR_SEC_POSITION_FLOW where FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} AND TRADE_ID=#{entrustId} and OFFSET_ID is null and OFFSET_FLAG = '01' group by PORTFOLIO_ID,SEC_ACCT_ID,FINPROD_ID,BRANCH,INV_AIM,HODING_TYPE,CDATE,ccy,P_FINPROD_ID,TRADE_ID
SELECT NVL(SUM(ENT_FINISH_AMT),0) FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId} and TRADE_ID != #{entrustId}
SELECT NVL(SUM(FINISH_AMT),0) FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId} and TRADE_ID != #{entrustId}

select sum(amount) amount,PORTFOLIO_ID,ACCT_ID,HODING_TYPE,CDATE,ccy,order_id,CHL_FINPROD_ID from PTL_CASH_POSITION_FLOW where ORDER_ID=#{tradeId} group by PORTFOLIO_ID,ACCT_ID,HODING_TYPE,CDATE,ccy,order_id,CHL_FINPROD_ID

select sum(amount) amount,PORTFOLIO_ID,SEC_ACCT_ID,FINPROD_ID,BRANCH,INV_AIM,HODING_TYPE,CDATE,ccy,P_FINPROD_ID from PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW where TRADE_ID=#{tradeId} group by PORTFOLIO_ID,SEC_ACCT_ID,FINPROD_ID,BRANCH,INV_AIM,HODING_TYPE,CDATE,ccy,P_FINPROD_ID

select PCPF.AMOUNT,PCPF.PORTFOLIO_ID,PCPF.ACCT_ID,PCPF.HODING_TYPE,PCPF.CDATE,PCPF.CCY,PCPF.ORDER_ID,PCPF.CHL_FINPROD_ID,PCPF.ENTRUST_ID from PTL_CASH_POSITION_FLOW PCPF LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS SPO ON PCPF.ORDER_ID = SPO.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD ON TPD.TRADE_ID = SPO.TRADE_ID where PCPF.ENTRUST_ID= #{entrustId} and PCPF.OFFSET_ID is null and PCPF.OFFSET_FLAG = '01' AND (TPD.TRADE_ID IS NULL OR (TPD.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TPD.IS_CANCEL = 'N'))
AND PCPF.CDATE = #{cDate,jdbcType=DATE}

select T.AMOUNT, T.PORTFOLIO_ID, T.SEC_ACCT_ID, T.FINPROD_ID, T.BRANCH, T.INV_AIM, T.HODING_TYPE, T.CDATE, T.ccy, T.P_FINPROD_ID, T.TRADE_ID from PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW T where T.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId} and OFFSET_ID is null and OFFSET_FLAG = '01'
AND T.HODING_TYPE = #{hodingType}

SELECT NVL(T2.COUNTER_ID,T1.COUNTER_ID) counterId FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_TEMP_DEAL T1 ON T.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.PS IN ('03','04') LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T2 ON T.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.PS IN ('03','04') WHERE T.FINPROD_ID = #{tradeId}
SELECT T.FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T WHERE T.FINPROD_ID = #{tradeId}
select CUR_DATE from SYS_DATE

SELECT MAX(PTL_SEC_POSITION.INV_AIM) FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE PTL_SEC_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.CDATE = ( SELECT MAX(PTL_SEC_POSITION.CDATE) FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.HODING_TYPE = '03')

SELECT DISTINCT std.* FROM settle_trans_data std LEFT JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_TG_MAPPING sttm ON sttm.TRADE_ID = std.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL trd ON trd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = sttm.TRADE_ID_TG WHERE trd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totalTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
